Umbrella of skeletal dysplasias defined by congenital stippled bone calcification; other organ findings vary by subtype.
Peripheral motor-sensory neuropathy; persistent structural foot deformity, including pes cavus, occurs in 30-79%.
Generalized proximal renal tubular dysfunction with phosphate and bicarbonate wasting defines the renal and electrolyte/acid-base disorder.
Hereditary corticospinal degeneration with spastic paraplegia in 5/5; spasms reflect neurologic dysfunction without demonstrated muscle damage.
Inherited skeletal dysplasia with stippled calcifications and shortened distal phalanges; no supported common extra-skeletal damage.
Developmental malformation of the cerebral cortex; epilepsy and developmental impairment belong to the same neurologic axis.
Heart and brain malformations define syndrome; visual impairment and camptodactyly each reported in 1/2; cleft lip (1/2) omitted by cap.

Carcinoma originates in the thymus, outside the specified axes; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease or immune dysfunction.

Nonsyndromic intellectual disability with motor delay; the broad carbohydrate-transport ancestor does not establish a metabolic disorder.
Juvenile motor neuron degeneration; fixed joint contractures and scoliosis each reported in 2/3, with muscle atrophy in 1/3.
Defining skeletal malformations and oral palatal abnormalities; dental abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Facial appearance alone adds no axis.

Defining absence or dysfunction of T lymphocytes, sometimes also B cells; respiratory infections are separately diagnosed consequences of immunodeficiency.
Neoplasm occupying the femur; bone is the defining anatomical site.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm morphology and motility; reproductive function is outside the axes, without endocrine dysfunction.
Distal motor neuronopathy with neuropathic EMG; established denervation muscle atrophy in upper and lower limbs reported in 1/2.
Carcinoma originates in breast epithelium, outside the specified axes; metastatic organ disease is not inherent to this concept.
Nonsyndromic intellectual disability and developmental delay in 5/5; mitral valve prolapse in 1/5 is below threshold.
Monogenic diabetes defines endocrine pancreatic dysfunction; diabetic organ complications are separate diseases.
Bulbospinal degeneration, typical ophthalmoplegia and deafness define syndrome; progressive denervation muscle wasting is characteristic, but frequency is unquantified.
